recommendation: Keep this fixed commit. Remaining uses of prescription/order in MedicationRequest source describe other medication-order concepts outside the status-code wording requested by FHIR-32859; any broader wording sweep should be handled by a separate Pharmacy WG decision.

Confluence references only pointed to Jira updates, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. Later status-code maintenance did not correct these stale status descriptions.
